title: Algerian Cod with Roasted Flavor
description: A unique Chinese-inspired recipe that combines Algerian spices with the classic flavors of roasted cod, all baked to perfection.

ingredients.name: Algerian spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets.

ingredients.name: Roasted garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince roasted garlic for best flavor.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: For roasting garlic and baking cod.

ingredients.name: Lime wedges
ingredients.notes: Serve with wedges for added flavor and moisture.

instructions: Season cod fillets with Algerian spice blend, salt, and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add minced roasted garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Place cod fillets in the pan and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes or until cod is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve with lime wedges.
